title: Startup failures apply the safe fix themselves
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Port in use, stale pid/lock, missing directory or corrupt state: apply the safe fix and continue, report what was done, never demand a manual step. Tests zc_startup_autofix_*.
